devcon_intro.heading:
Devcon returns with four days for
the vision that started it all
devcon_intro.subheading: Devcon is the annual global event for the movement building free, open, private, and verifiable systems. This year, it comes to Mumbai.

why_india.heading: Devcon is in Mumbai to champion what India is already building
why_india.lead: Devcon is where the people behind decentralized systems come together to learn, build, and connect, and this year it calls Mumbai home.
why_india.body: Engineering talent runs deep in India, and its open-source community is expanding faster than almost any other in the world. Mumbai is where that energy and creative spirit gathers, and this November it's where Ethereum's does, too.

join_event.heading: Gather with the curious, the builders, and the explorers
join_event.subheading: Devcon is where the builders of a brighter future gather to learn, connect and co-create.

cards.title: Learn what's coming next
cards.body: Deeply technical and deeply human sessions on decentralized systems, new forms of coordination, and open code. Hear how the people building them are shaping the future.
cards.image_alt: A speaker presenting on stage at Devcon

cards.title: Connect with fellow builders
cards.body: Meet the people behind the world's open source communities, core contributors, researchers, students, and artists, from India's thriving ecosystem and across the world.
cards.image_alt: A community photo wall at Devcon

cards.title: Leave with more than just notes
cards.body: Make new friends, build working relationships, find people to create with, and reignite your passions, all while exploring the latest in Ethereum and open source tech.
cards.image_alt: A group of Devcon attendees having fun together

cards.title: The spirit of a global reunion
cards.body: Art, music, hands-on experiences, and spaces created by and for the Devcon community itself. Devcon has been a labor of love since 2014. You feel it the moment you walk in.
cards.image_alt: A live art performance at Devcon

tracks.heading: This year's tracks

plan_trip.heading: Plan your trip
plan_trip.lead: There's a Devcon welcome booth waiting at the airport, and the metro reaches the venue in about five minutes.
plan_trip.body: Our travel guide covers all the details you need, including where to stay, how to pay, and what to explore. Note that Devcon overlaps with Diwali season, India's biggest holiday, so book your stay early.

contribute.heading: Help make Devcon happen
contribute.subheading: There's a role at Devcon for all kinds of contributors. Speak on stage, organize a hub, bring your project, or volunteer to make the event happen.

cards.title: Speak at Devcon
cards.body: Help to shape the conversation at Devcon and engage thousands of builders, researchers, designers, and thinkers from across the decentralized ecosystem.

cards.title: Organize a Community Hub
cards.body: Community-led, educational and marketing-free spaces built around a specific topic in Ethereum, CROPS or FLOSS. Choose your topic, gather a team, post a proposal.

cards.title: Volunteer at Devcon
cards.body: Join a team of passionate contributors keeping Devcon running smoothly. From registration desks to behind-the-scenes management.

item_1.q: When will General ticket sales start?
item_1.a: General Admission ticket sales for Devcon India will launch in early May. Stay tuned for updates as we get closer to this date.

item_2.q: Will there be opportunities to obtain discounted tickets?
item_2.a_intro: Yes! There will be multiple ways to obtain discounted tickets this year:
item_2.community_b: This will consist of groups like Protocol Guild members, OSS Contributors and more.
item_2.applications_b: This will include Builder Discounts, Student Discounts, and Youth Tickets for those under 18.
item_2.ecosystem_b: An application will be open for leaders & organizers of various web2 & web3 communities or meetups to apply for free or discounted tickets for their groups.

item_3.q: Can I purchase tickets with crypto?
item_3.a: Yes! You will be able to choose between Credit Card or Crypto to pay for your ticket. Orders paid in Crypto receive a 3% discount on the total cost.
